data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that shows a stack of cards swipable like the iMessage image picker.
data.what_it_does: It presents a list of widgets as a swipeable deck where the top card can be swiped left or right. Callbacks inform you of swipe direction and the current index, and you can adjust the spread of background cards.
use_when: You need a simple swipe‑through UI for images or cards
You want quick integration with minimal configuration
avoid_when: You require complex animations or highly custom gestures
You need advanced pagination or data loading logic
strengths: Very easy to add to a project
Provides left/right swipe callbacks and index tracking
Allows basic visual customization of card spread
weaknesses: Few customization options beyond spread and callbacks
No built‑in support for lazy loading or pagination
data.minimal_example:
SwipeDeck(
  startIndex: 0,
  onSwipeLeft: () => print('left'),
  onSwipeRight: () => print('right'),
  onChange: (i) => print('index $i'),
  widgets: images.map((e) => Image.asset('assets/$e.jpg')).toList(),
);
